description: Read a SmartUI project's baseline settings, or merge baselines across branches or builds. merge_branch/merge_build resolve source and target names to builds, merge them, then poll the merged build and report its real terminal status — a merge that lands in error or with zero screenshots is returned as a tool error, not as success. Merging permanently changes baseline state: the merged build takes the baseline flag, so a failed merge leaves the baseline on an empty build.

action.description: get_settings reads baseline config; merge_branch/merge_build merge baselines

source.description: Source branch (merge_branch) or build name (merge_build) to merge FROM

target.description: Target branch (merge_branch) or build name (merge_build) to merge INTO

name: smartui_baseline_manage
title: SmartUI Baseline Manage
